title: Mesoneer mixes custom software and process automation with its own e-signature products
content:
Mesoneer AG delivers custom software and process automation from Zurich and also ships its own e-signature and identity products, with a fintech lean. That mix — services plus own products — is the finding, because the two halves imply different behaviour toward a third-party layer.

The services half is a straightforward carrier profile: custom software plus process automation is exactly where an append-only decision record attaches. The product half is the model the screen treats as a conflict elsewhere in the corpus, in Glintt's healthtech products and PinkRoccade's vertical software: a firm with its own roadmap answers a missing capability by building it, and a partner layer competes with a release plan it already sells.

The specific products sharpen the question rather than settling it. E-signature and identity are adjacent to decision provenance — signing and identity are how an approval is bound to a person — so there is a real chance of overlap with what the record layer asserts, and an equally real chance of complementarity, since the signature proves who acted while the record holds the ordered account of what was decided. Which of the two applies is the thing to establish before a pitch. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
